description: The Reinecker creek trail system is made up of two trails that parallel the creek. The West trail is a multi-use trail with motorized use allowed and is roughly 10km long starting from the Margaret falls parking lot. The east trail is non-motorized also 10km and starts from the north end of Herald park. Two crossing points link the trails, one at the north end and one about half way along the two trails which allows for loop and figure 8 routes passing through several different forest types.
directions: Access is via the Bastion Mountain FSR and Herald Provincial Park
title: Reinecker
